core_obligations: Identify the n-th piece of the cone with the n-th exterior power of E' = E plus R, mapping the added generator to e_0 and using the decomposition of the cone in degree n (proof lines 6709-6715).
Check that this identification is compatible with the differentials on the first summand, where the enlarged map restricts to the original map (proof lines 6716-6719).

Check compatibility on the second summand by expanding the cone differential and the Koszul differential of the enlarged map and comparing the two expressions term by term, including the signs (proof lines 6720-6745).
Conclude that the Koszul complex of the enlarged map is isomorphic to the cone of multiplication by f, which is the statement (proof lines 6744-6745).

difficulty_reason: The lemma is the abstract form of the statement that a Koszul complex on a longer sequence is the mapping cone of multiplication by the new element on the previous Koszul complex (statement lines 6694-6706). The proof is a 40-line computation (proof lines 6709-6748): it observes that the n-th piece of the cone is the direct sum of the n-th and (n-1)-st pieces of the old Koszul complex, identifies that sum with the n-th exterior power of the enlarged module E' = E plus R by sending the added generator to the basis element e_0, and then verifies compatibility with the differentials in two steps, the first summand being immediate and the second requiring the explicit unfolding of both differentials and a comparison of the signs. The differential comparison in the second case is the substance of the lemma and it is written out in full; nothing is delegated to another statement and no citation is used.
